messages:
Anya: Heads-up - Orion Bank emailed: 6y retention request, BYOK (EU KMS) + optional HSM attestation, tenant legal-hold toggles, and auditor-ready export artifacts (signed manifest + per-file checksum). They want a commercial proposal next quarter. Can we triage scope?
Rafa (Sales): They want search for last 24 months, export-only beyond that. Are we okay selling a pilot before full 6y support?
Rohit (Product): Pilot sounds right. Proposed MVP: 1) tenant retention up to 2y + export API 2) legal-hold flag to stop deletes 3) signed NDJSON export manifest. Phase 2: extend retention to 6y, BYOK/HSM attestation, hot/warm/cold tiers.
Isha (Security): BYOK must accept key refs/ARNs only; no plaintext key uploads. For HSM we need attestation and KMS audit forwarding. Export manifests need platform signature + nonce.
Marta (Legal): Manifest should include exporter id, UTC timestamps, sha256 per file, retention_policy_version, and legal_hold_state. Also need documented deletion-appeal process for contracts.
Ben (SRE): Ops sizing: 6y ~80-140TB depending on embeddings. Hot search for 24mo feasible; full 6y search not unless we budget heavily. Export SLA: 72h for ~50TB with parallel workers seems plausible.
Rafa (Sales): Orion might accept 72h initially. They asked for an onboarding playbook and SLA language.
sysbot: Created ticket CUST-1655: "Orion Bank - retention/BYOK/export request" assigned to product-compliance squad.
Rohit (Product): Action items: Isha spike BYOK (due Wed), Ben cost + export-worker sizing (due Wed), Marta draft manifest contract language (due Fri), Rafa confirm KMS vendor and HSM requirement.
Anya: Proposed sync Fri 10am to review spikes. Add notes to CUST-1655 if you can't make it. :calendar:
